instruction: Hold the adversarial theme-security line end to end: hostile theme uploads must be rejected, preview routes must stay isolated between tenants and unauthenticated callers, the CSS-gate differential must hold in the browser, and frame CPU recovery must behave. Playwright spawns and kills its own loopback vite server via .e2e/playwright.config.ts; start no other servers and leave none running. The verifier passes only when all specs across the five files pass.
title: Adversarial theme-security specs pass in a real browser
